2x 2on2 tournaments, '''Monday 2nd August - Tuesday 3rd August''', with one tournament per day. 
One-night tournaments in best of 3 format, with fraglimit.

== Format ==
* Single-Elimination, Fraglimit
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} 

* '''MONDAY 2/8''' : DM2, DM4, DM6, AEROWALK, ZTNDM3 (timelimit 25 min per map, fraglimit 100)
* '''TUESDAY 3/8''' : BRAVADO, SHIFTER, SKULL, CATALYST, MONSOON, ULTRAV, TEKNO, ZTNDM3Q -  (timelimit 20 min per map, fraglimit 100)
